pre_outcome_source_format_correction: The first preflight stopped before name, distribution or model outcomes because PowerShell had rendered the GBIF UTC timestamp in Asia/Tokyo. The contract now records the unchanged API timestamp verbatim.
name_resolution_rule: Resolve an input canonical name only when all exact WCVP canonical-name records with usable accepted keys converge on one accepted WCVP key; otherwise mark the taxon unresolved and exclude it from native-only models.
distribution_rule: Treat WCVP TDWG level-3 records with blank or NATIVE establishmentMeans as native and INTRODUCED as introduced. Conflicting, doubtful, unknown or unlisted statuses are excluded rather than guessed.
geometry_rule: Assign an observation only when its longitude/latitude point lies within exactly one pinned TDWG level-3 polygon. Boundary, overlap and unmapped points are excluded.
model_family: Rerun all nine endpoints by four CHELSA predictors on native-status observations with the frozen taxon-mean within-taxon OLS, taxon-clustered uncertainty and BH across 36 rows.
strict_retention_rule: A previously supported non-circular row is native-range robust only if its native-only standardized beta has the frozen sign and BH q < 0.05. No minimum coverage threshold is used to rescue or discard a result after outcome inspection; coverage is reported directly.
immutability_rule: Do not change accepted-name convergence, distribution classification, geometry assignment, multiplicity or retention rules after inspecting outcomes. Any change requires a new contract version and preserved prior result.
